title: Execute alias-safe tensor-codebook W4 plus grouped Dynamic Scale32 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after the complete pre-attempt artifact set, model-only error gate, non-evaluator 8/8 quality gate, dynamic 312-event gate, and every bound hash pass verification.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated candidate-specific runner that preserves the verified alias-safe lm_head split and grouped Dynamic Scale32 activation policy while replacing uniform signed-int4 weight values with deterministic per-Linear 16-entry signed-Q4.4 codebooks addressed by 4-bit indices. Do not modify or import mutable state from any consumed attempt directory.

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: Clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before codebook construction and set only the in-memory config tie_word_embeddings field false
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linear weights plus the separated lm_head weight
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding Parameter object, storage pointer, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged

tensor_codebook_weight_policy.payload: unsigned 4-bit codebook index 0 through 15; even flat element low nibble, odd flat element high nibble
tensor_codebook_weight_policy.row_scale: preserve the authenticated 32-bit per-output-row Scale32 record
tensor_codebook_weight_policy.codebook: exactly one aligned 16-byte record per Linear tensor; byte i is strictly increasing signed-Q4.4 codepoint i
tensor_codebook_weight_policy.construction: pinned BF16 weights only; exact Q4.4 histogram; initial codepoints [-128,-112,-96,-80,-64,-48,-32,-16,0,16,32,48,64,80,96,112]; exactly 32 Lloyd-Max iterations; nearest assignment ties choose lower index; centroid updates round ties-to-even; empty clusters retain prior point; duplicate or out-of-range points fail closed
tensor_codebook_weight_policy.reconstruction: decoded row Scale32 multiplied by signed codebook int8 and divided by 16

dynamic_activation_policy.selection: preserve each frozen base Scale32 significand and select the minimum legal exponent delta in [-24,+24] that keeps the effective exponent in [-24,+4] and covers every finite group lane

accelerator_facing_contract.codebook_transport: one 128-bit aligned external-memory beat per Linear tensor, cached before the tensor's weight stream
accelerator_facing_contract.fixed_point_compute: A8 times signed-Q4.4 codepoint with integer accumulation and fixed fractional shift four; no floating-point RTL

pre_attempt_artifact_set.non_evaluator_inputs: the immutable four-prompt calibration contract plus Name one primary color in one lowercase word.; Return only the integer result of 9 multiplied by 7.; In five words, describe gentle rain.; Answer yes or no: Is water wet?
required_before_marker: hash-bound runner source and self-test result
candidate A and B state, payload, row-scale, and codebook manifests
codebook self-test covering determinism, exact iteration count, ties-to-even, assignment ties, empty clusters, duplicate rejection, range rejection, nibble packing, and hash mismatch rejection
model-only reconstruction report with no per-tensor regression and strict aggregate improvement
8/8 non-evaluator exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes
fresh-candidate dynamic preflight with all 312 layer/event names, legal delta range, zero saturation, zero clipping, and no reserved -128 activation payload
predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix, runner, tool-version, format, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve the no-go evidence, leave the official attempt unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the bounded result for Fresh Review without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

engineer_objective: Implement and self-test the fresh tensor-codebook runner without modifying consumed artifacts; prove exact alias-safe candidate A/B construction and model-only reconstruction improvement; pass 8/8 non-evaluator exactness and the 312-event dynamic preflight without an attempt marker; then, only if every pre-attempt gate passes, consume exactly one attempt-0001 over the unchanged nine-prompt matrix and submit immutable evidence to a Fresh Reviewer.
acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer independently verifies task/hash closure, source-tied then runtime-split lm_head behavior, preserved embedding bytes, deterministic 169-tensor codebook construction within 4.036 bits/weight, passed pre-attempt gates, legal Dynamic Scale32 execution, and—if the official marker was created—9/9 exact BF16 token sequences plus 9/9 matching response-gate outcomes; selected_policy_id changes only after that adjudication.
prohibited_work: modify, reclaim, resume, rename, replay, complete, or reinterpret any consumed Option-B attempt
create the new execution marker during planning, runner development, codebook construction, or preflight
use any official nine-prompt input, output, token array, or response gate for codebook construction or preflight
add per-group or per-scalar weight metadata, sparse prompt-specific exceptions, or more than one 16-byte codebook per Linear tensor
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
begin U280 integration, emulation, bitstream, or board work
